screen_basis.threshold: PURSUE iff the interface constant n is <= about 7; otherwise IN_SCOPE_VACUOUS.
screen_basis.basis: DEC-20260731-014's IN_SCOPE_VACUOUS ruling on Proposition 801-1, whose interface constant 2 + 2*n* = 32 exceeds the 3-7 in-scope round window of RQ-AES-001 under PROP-701-I's own one-interface-per-round convention. Language and threshold deliberately identical to TASK-20260801-806's screen.
screen_basis.anti_relabelling_clause: The screen is on the argument's iteration count over interfaces however the iteration is packaged. Repackaging n steps as one lemma does not change n.
screen_basis.important_distinction_recorded_up_front: PROP-701-I's Step 3 iterates the (lambda,k) graph, but for a ROUND-INDEPENDENT pi every one of those iterations happens AT THE SAME SINGLE INTERFACE with the SAME pi: the graph traversal is over the invariance group, not over interfaces. Its interface constant is therefore n = 1, not 32. Proposition 801-1's constant is 32 only because its pi is LAYER-DEPENDENT, so each graph step must be paid for with two fresh interfaces. Hole (ii) and OD-3 both keep round-independence and drop other hypotheses, so arguments in their setting can have n = 1 even though they traverse the same graph. This distinction is stated here, before any work, so that it cannot be constructed afterwards to dodge the screen.

interface_prescreen.statement: For a state set S restricted to a structured subset, Step 2's sweep of u_k = sum_l M[k][l] y_l + (k_j)_k over F is controlled by which coordinates of the pre-MixColumns vector y^(j) remain free in S; compute the reachable-set size |{u_k}| exhaustively for the named families of S.
interface_prescreen.routes_through_instead: A single F-linear functional (row k of M) evaluated on the achievable set of pre-MixColumns vectors. One interface, no iteration of any kind, no use of the (lambda,k) graph. The interface screen does not apply because there is no interface iteration to count; n = 1 is recorded for completeness.

interface_prescreen.statement: Under a restricted state set S, compute the fixpoint of PROP-701-I's Step 1 / Step 2 / Step 3 machinery: which translations t the machinery reaches, on which subsets of F^4 the invariance pi(w) = pi(w+t) is obtained, and whether constancy is still forced.
interface_prescreen.interface_constant_justification: pi is ROUND-INDEPENDENT here (hole (ii) drops only the state quantifier of (H2), not the round-independence of PROP-701-I). Every application of Steps 1-3 is at the SAME interface Phi with the SAME pi, so the whole fixpoint consumes exactly one interface however many graph steps it takes. Contrast Proposition 801-1, n = 2 + 2*n* = 32, where pi is layer-dependent and each graph step costs two interfaces.

interface_prescreen.statement: A LAYER-DEPENDENT projection family whose propagation requirement is restricted to a structured state subset is closed after N consecutive interfaces.
interface_prescreen.interface_constant_justification: It inherits Proposition 801-1's constant 2 + 2*n* = 32 as a LOWER bound: restricting the domain can only slow the covering, never speed it, since each graph step is obtained from a strictly weaker premise.
interface_prescreen.action: NOT PURSUED. No derivation of it is attempted anywhere in this package.

interface_prescreen.statement: Iterate the restricted-domain closure ACROSS successive interfaces, tracking how the admissible domain Phi(S), Phi^2(S), ... grows, and obtain a closure for objects that propagate on a restricted domain for several rounds.
interface_prescreen.interface_constant_n: NO UPPER BOUND COULD BE EXHIBITED
interface_prescreen.interface_constant_justification: The number of interfaces is exactly the number of domain-growth steps tracked, and nothing in this task bounds how many are needed before the domain is large enough for the unrestricted argument to restart. An argument with no exhibited upper bound on n fails the screen by the screen's own rule.
interface_prescreen.action: NOT PURSUED. Recorded as a named residual of group (b) instead.

interface_prescreen.statement: For SET-VALUED per-word objects, the set-valued analogue of (H2) requires the output word's object to be a function of the four input words' MARGINAL objects; exhibit a computed witness (two state sets with identical per-word marginals and different output marginals) that separates the objects this permits from the objects it forbids.
interface_prescreen.routes_through_instead: The cross-word coupling introduced by ShiftRows: each pre-MixColumns vector collects one byte from each of the four input words, so the output object depends on the JOINT content of the set across words while a per-word set object records only marginals. This is a single-interface counting statement about ShiftRows, not a translation-invariance statement, so no (lambda,k) traversal occurs and the interface screen has nothing to count.

interface_prescreen.statement: Lift pi to sets by pi(S) := the image object of S and re-run PROP-701-I's Steps 1-3 verbatim on the lifted object.
interface_prescreen.interface_constant_justification: Same as PROP-701-I itself: round-independent pi, one interface, graph traversal over the invariance group.
interface_prescreen.note: Pursued only far enough to determine which of Steps 1, 2, 3 survive, break or are undefined under the lift. No new closure is derived from it.

interface_prescreen.statement: A layer-dependent family of set-valued per-word objects is closed after N consecutive interfaces (the set-valued analogue of Proposition 801-1).
interface_prescreen.interface_constant_justification: Inherits Proposition 801-1's constant, and set-valued hypotheses are strictly weaker than the single-state ones that produced it, so the constant cannot decrease.

novelty_screen_group_a.rule: Screened BEFORE any effort against: integral/square balance, Demirci-Selcuk MITM multisets, division property, impossible differential, boomerang/retracing, biclique. Anything reducing to a coordinate-wise sum or to a single-byte multiset over a delta-set is recorded as a REDISCOVERY with the family named and dropped. Every literature recollection here is UNVERIFIED-FROM-MEMORY; no primary source is reachable in this environment, so 'matches a family recalled from memory' is the strongest form any of these verdicts takes, and none of them says 'known to be known'.

candidates.object: Coordinate-wise XOR sum of the word values over the set S: sum_{s in S} word_j(s).
candidates.recall_confidence: HIGH that this is the integral balance property; unverified-from-memory.
candidates.action: DROPPED before any effort. Retained only as a REFERENCE OBJECT in the group (a) witness computation, where its role is to be the object that is expected to survive, i.e. a control, not a candidate.

candidates.object: Multiset of the values of ONE byte position over the set S.
candidates.action: DROPPED before any effort. Retained as a reference object in the witness computation only.

candidates.object: Multiset of the full 4-byte WORD values over S (not a single byte).
candidates.family: Demirci-Selcuk MITM multiset, at word granularity
candidates.reason: It is a multiset over a structured set of states; widening the observed unit from one byte to one word changes the granularity of the same family's statistic, not the family. Recorded as a rediscovery rather than dressed up as new.
candidates.action: DROPPED as a candidate. Retained as a reference object in the witness computation only.

candidates.object: Support size |{ word_j(s) : s in S }|, i.e. how many distinct word values the set realises.
candidates.family: integral / square (the A = 'all distinct' and C = 'constant' properties are exactly cardinality statements about this set)
candidates.action: DROPPED as a candidate. Retained as a reference object in the witness computation only.

candidates.object: F-affine rank of the set: dim_F of the F-span of { word_j(s) - word_j(s0) : s in S }.
candidates.family: subspace trails (and, at one remove, the differential family: for a coset it is the dimension of the carrier)
candidates.reason: This is neither a coordinate-wise sum nor a single-byte multiset, so it PASSES the two-member warning of OD-3, but it fails the wider screen: for a coset it is precisely the subspace-trail carrier dimension, an object PROP-701-I's own OBJ-701-2 already records as a probable rediscovery.
candidates.recall_confidence: LOW-MEDIUM on the precise literature statement, MEDIUM on the existence of the subspace-trail literature; unverified-from-memory.
candidates.action: DROPPED as a candidate. Retained as a reference object in the witness computation only.

candidates.object: Difference set { word_j(s) + word_j(s') : s, s' in S } of the set.
candidates.family: differential / subspace trail (for a coset it IS the carrier subspace; for a general set it is the difference-multiset object of differential cryptanalysis lifted to a set)

candidates.object: Walsh/Fourier support of the indicator function of { word_j(s) : s in S }.
candidates.family: linear cryptanalysis (masks), and its set-valued reading is the correlation/linear-hull statistic

candidates.object: Monomial/degree support of the set's indicator, i.e. the algebraic-normal-form support.

novelty_screen_group_a.anticipated_outcome_recorded_before_the_: If every enumerated candidate lands in a named family, the outcome recorded is NO_ADMISSIBLE_MEMBER together with the enumeration and the structural reason, in the same form BATCH-002's ideation recorded NO_ADMISSIBLE_NEXT_MECHANISM. No member will be invented to have something to report.

pre_registered_predictions.status: FROZEN. Written before any code existed and before any measurement. Reproduced verbatim in section 0 of od3_and_hole_ii_report.md. A prediction adjusted after seeing a reading is a protocol violation, not a refinement; any discrepancy will be reported AS a discrepancy.
pre_registered_predictions.analogue: GF(2^4) with modulus x^4+x+1, MixColumns-shaped circulant first row (02,03,01,01), 4 words x 4 rows = 16 field elements per state. This is the same scaled-down analogue GATE-701-C v2 used in TASK-20260801-801. It IS an analogue; nothing measured in it is evidence about GF(2^8) and nothing in it is about AES.
pre_registered_predictions.P_b1: For every state set S that is a coset of a COORDINATE subspace (this class contains every delta-set and every fixed-byte set), the reachable set { u_k : u in U_i } has size exactly 1 or exactly |F| = 16, with no intermediate value, for every k; and it is |F| exactly when at least one of the three pre-MixColumns coordinates other than the fixed one is free in S.
pre_registered_predictions.P_b2: For a single-active-byte delta-set the sweep is TOTALLY broken: reach size 1 for every k, in every admissible configuration.
pre_registered_predictions.P_b3: For the classical 4-active-byte delta-set whose active bytes lie on ONE ShiftRows diagonal, the sweep is FULL (reach = |F|) and the free-coordinate count is maximal (3) for the ONE output word index whose diagonal is the active one, and reach = 1 for the other three output word indices.
pre_registered_predictions.P_b4: For fixed-byte sets in which all but at most three bytes are free, the sweep is full for every (word, row, k) configuration in which Step 1 is admissible at all.
pre_registered_predictions.P_b5: Over an exhaustive enumeration of all 2^16 = 65536 coordinate-active patterns A on the 16 state positions, the number of patterns for which the FULL unrestricted argument is available -- i.e. there exists an input word p with all 12 positions outside word p active and at least one position inside word p active -- is exactly 57 (= 4*15 - 3, the all-16 pattern being counted four times).
pre_registered_predictions.P_b6: For state sets that are GF(2)-affine but NOT F-affine, INTERMEDIATE reach sizes strictly between 1 and 16 DO occur (sizes must be powers of two, and 2, 4 and 8 will all be observed in a seeded sample).
pre_registered_predictions.P_b7: The closure computation will force pi constant for exactly those active patterns identified by P_b5's criterion, and for no others among the named family.
pre_registered_predictions.P_b8_positive_control: With A = all 16 positions active (no restriction), the closure forces pi constant for EVERY seed (word p, row i, scalar lambda). This is the positive control: it must reproduce PROP-701-I's own conclusion, and if it does not, the implementation is wrong and the whole group (b) reading is VOID.
pre_registered_predictions.P_b9_null_1: With M replaced by the identity (negating BOTH 'every entry of M is nonzero' and strong connectivity of the (lambda,k) graph), constancy is NOT forced for any single-coordinate seed.
pre_registered_predictions.P_b10_null_2: With M replaced by an invertible circulant containing a ZERO entry (negating 'every entry of M is nonzero' while leaving the field and the general shape alone), constancy is NOT forced for at least some seeds.
pre_registered_predictions.P_b11_null_3_isolation: With M replaced by an invertible circulant whose entries are ALL NONZERO but whose (lambda,k) graph is NOT strongly connected (negating only the strong-connectivity ingredient), constancy is NOT forced. If this null instead behaves like the target, then this statistic -- exactly like GATE-701-C v2 under defect V-804-1 -- DISCRIMINATES without ISOLATING strong connectivity, and that will be reported as a failure of isolation, not glossed.
pre_registered_predictions.P_a1: In the group (a) coupling witness, two state sets with identical per-word marginals but different cross-word coupling will produce IDENTICAL output coordinate-wise XOR sums (OBJ-807-1 survives, as the integral family must) and DIFFERENT output word multisets, support sizes and F-affine ranks (OBJ-807-3, -4, -5 broken).
pre_registered_predictions.P_a2: The group (a) enumeration will terminate in NO_ADMISSIBLE_MEMBER: every enumerated set-valued candidate lands in a named family.

controls_declared_before_measurement.positive_control: A = all 16 active, target matrix. Must reproduce PROP-701-I's conclusion (constancy forced for every seed).
controls_declared_before_measurement.null_1: identity matrix. Named ingredient negated: every entry of M nonzero, AND strong connectivity of the (lambda,k) graph (it negates both at once, which is why it alone cannot isolate).
controls_declared_before_measurement.null_2: first invertible circulant, in a fixed a-priori lexicographic scan order over GF(2^4) first rows containing exactly one zero entry. Named ingredient negated: every entry of M nonzero, ALONE.
controls_declared_before_measurement.null_3_sibling: an invertible circulant with all entries nonzero whose (lambda,k) graph is not strongly connected, in the shape of the (01,01,01,08) matrix defect V-804-1 used. Named ingredient negated: strong connectivity of the (lambda,k) graph, ALONE.
controls_declared_before_measurement.isolation_statement: null_2 and null_3 are SIBLINGS that negate the two named ingredients SEPARATELY, which null_1 negates together. This is the direct response to V-804-1, where a control discriminated without isolating the ingredient it named. If null_2 and null_3 do not separate, the failure of isolation is reported as such.
VOID_conditions: VOID-A: if the positive control (A = all 16, target matrix) does NOT force constancy, the implementation is wrong and every group (b) reading in this package is VOID.
VOID-B: if a null reads identically to the positive control, the statistic does not isolate the ingredient that null negates, and that is reported as a failure of isolation.
